# Camp Resource: Cement Truck

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 18, 2024
- 1 min read

Updated: Apr 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_db7892ebfec34850a3a57be0583a101e~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

Lucky for you this broken down Cement Truck still has some Cement in the back.

Generates Cement.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Cement Truck__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5120a91e5c48493a8e1c5700d300d526~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Concrete Scrap

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Mix-O-Matic

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resource

**Holds**

40 pieces

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Cement Truck__ - 700 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 1 minute and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

10 power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hi, I'm Kat or Duchess
